Manx: unnid kiare-jeig she manninagh mish
she yernagh uss she albinagh eshyn
she bretnagh ish she manninee shinyn
nee shiuish she albinee adsyn
she bretnagh guen she coyrnagh yn dooinney
she yn dooinney s'jerree mish cha nee manninagh mish
cha nee ben uss cha nee dooinney aeg as
cha nee eirinagh ish cha nee manninee shinyn
cha nee mraane shiuish cha nee deiney aegey adsyn
cha nee eirinagh berchagh jamys
cha nee eeasteyryn ven nee frangagh nish
nuy bancair uss nuy iddaalagh eshyn
nee immanagh ish nee frangee shinyn
nuy bancaaryn shiuish ny iddaalee adsyn
nee studeyr markys ny gareyderyn ven
nagh nee fer-ynsee mish nagh nee shiaulteyr uss
nagh nee skybbyltagh boght eshyn nagh nee sheeanagh ish
nagh nee fir-ynsee shinyn nagh nee shiaulteyryn shiuish
nagh nee skibbyltee boghtey adsyn nagh nee maayl
nagh nee sostynagh she dooinney va mish
she eeasteyr voses cha nee eirinagh veshyn
cha nee banceyr voish ny manninee va shinyn
nee albinee va shiuish nagh gow va juan
she moddey tayn cha nee emshyr vie t'ayn
ny billy t'ayn nagh nee thie thooit t'ayn
she moddey voyn cha nee emshyr vie ayn
nee billey v'ayn nagh nee thie thooit v'ayn
